grades: Current or rising high school student
name: Summer Medical Camp
org: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso, Foster School of Medicine
what_you_do: Meet health care workers. Go on field trips. Try a mock crime scene. Do a reality store task about the cost of life. Learn about college and money for school.
who_can_apply: Current or rising high school students who are interested in a medical career and can attend in person from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. every day.
pay_detail: Snacks and learning materials are free. Camp cost is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The 2026 camps ran June 8 to 18 and June 22 to July 2. Dates for the next camp will be announced closer to next summer.
how_to_apply: The program page does not describe an application. It says students hear about the camp when staff visit high schools in the El Paso region. Call René André at 915-215-4408.
notes: The program page has a link named Summer Med Camp Mentor. The page gives no details about that role.
